watches.name: GT Racing Chronograph Watch
watches.description: Inspired by the golden age of motorsport, the Geckota GT Chronograph captures the spirit of classic grand touring with a bold tachymeter bezel, twin-register layout and vivid chronograph accents. Its clean dial, applied markers and framed date at 6 o’clock give it a balanced, purposeful look, while the coloured central chronograph hand adds a sharp hit of racing character. At its heart is the Seiko VK64 meca-quartz chronograph movement , combining the everyday convenience and accuracy of quartz with the crisp, mechanical feel of a sweeping chronograph seconds hand. It is a practical choice for daily wear, offering reliable timekeeping with the tactile engagement expected from a proper chronograph. The case is made from stainless steel and fitted with a screw-in crown and screw-down case back , helping deliver 50m water resistance . A ceramic tachymeter bezel adds durability and a polished motorsport finish, while the acrylic crystal brings warmth, clarity and a distinctly vintage character. For low-light visibility, the hands and applied markers are finished with Swiss BGW9 luminous material , giving the watch a crisp blue glow after dark. Available in a choice of racing-inspired colourways, the GT Chronograph is sporty without being overdone: a refined, easy-wearing chronograph with classic trackside energy and modern reliability. Key features Seiko VK64 meca-quartz chronograph movement. Stainless steel case. Ceramic tachymeter bezel. Acrylic crystal. Screw-in crown. Screw-down case back. 50m water resistance. BGW9 luminous hands and markers. Twin-register chronograph layout. Applied hour markers. Framed date window at 6 o’clock. Racing-inspired colour accents.

watches.name: Workshop Model 2A Chronograph Watch
watches.description: Workshop Model 2 Chronograph The Workshop Model 2 Chronograph Collection brings together vintage-inspired design, mechanical character and classic proportions in a range of refined chronograph watches. From the original silver-dial to the Military and Racing editions, each model offers its own take on historic chronograph styling while remaining true to the Workshop collection’s elegant and wearable profile. Powered by the Seagull TY2901 hand-wound mechanical chronograph movement, the collection delivers traditional stopwatch functionality with a power reserve of around 42 hours. Dial designs range from the original silver stamped grain dial with tachymeter scale, to the military model with telemeter detailing and vintage lume, and the racing versions with bold panda and reverse panda-inspired layouts. An exhibition caseback reveals the movement within, adding another layer of mechanical appeal. With a 37mm case, 47mm lug-to-lug and 18mm lug width, the Workshop Model 2 Chronograph wears with vintage-inspired balance and versatility. It is a collection created for those who appreciate timeless chronograph design, thoughtful detail and the charm of a hand-wound movement. Key features Sea-Gull TY2901 hand-wound mechanical chronograph movement. Approximately 42 hours of power reserve. Exhibition caseback. Choice of classic, military and racing-inspired dial designs. Tachymeter or telemeter detailing, depending on model. 37mm case diameter. 47mm lug-to-lug. 18mm lug width.

watches.name: Workshop Model 1A Jumping Hour Small Seconds Watch
watches.description: Workshop Model 1 Jumping Hour A distinctive take on a classic complication, the Workshop Model 1 Jumping Hour combines vintage-inspired design with the charm of mechanical watchmaking. Inspired by the elegant proportions of traditional pocket watches, each model in the range offers a refined dress-watch profile paired with the satisfying character of a jumping hour display. At the heart of the collection is the Seagull TY2709 automatic jumping hour movement, placing the hour display at 12 o’clock for a clean, balanced layout and clear legibility. The collection is defined by its thoughtful dial design, recessed details and contrasting hands, all carefully chosen to enhance both style and readability. From the silvered multi-layered guilloché dial of the original models to the gloss lacquer dials of the Generation 2 editions, the Workshop range offers a choice of finishes and personalities while maintaining a cohesive design language throughout. The result is a collection that feels distinctive, elegant and full of character. Sized at 37mm with a 47mm lug-to-lug measurement and 18mm lug width, these watches wear with classic proportions that suit a wide range of wrists. A double-domed acrylic crystal completes the vintage-inspired look, adding warmth and charm to the overall design. Whether you prefer the depth of guilloché or the enamel-inspired gloss of the newer dial variants, the Workshop Jumping Hour Collection offers an original and beautifully considered approach to timekeeping. Key Features Seagull TY2709 automatic jumping hour movement. Jumping hour display at 12 o’clock. Vintage-inspired dress-watch proportions. Choice of guilloché or gloss lacquer dial finishes. Recessed subdial and hour window detailing. 37mm case diameter, 47mm lug-to-lug, 18mm lug width. Double-domed acrylic crystal.

watches.name: Classic Chronotimer Watch Grey Wolf
watches.description: Following the success of the original Chronotimer models, we are proud to present a new design which has been two years in the making and introduces an entirely redesigned case. The Geckota Sports Mechanical Chronotimer is presented in a choice of four dial variations: Grey, Green, Red and Teal. By popular demand, the Sports Chronotimer models are equipped with a hand-wound mechanical chronograph movement. The remodelled three-piece case of the Sports Chronotimer is presented with polished and brushed details, screw down case back, drilled through lugs and measures at a slim 12.35mm in total case height. Crafted from durable stainless steel, the 41.50mm cushion style case is accentuated with custom colour inserts on the crown and pushers, adding a unique flair to this elegant timepiece. Cleverly designed to wear smaller than its dimensions might suggest, it sits comfortably on the wrist while the 47.80mm lug-to-lug distance ensures a balanced fit for any occasion. Case material: Stainless steel with custom colour inserts on the crown and pushers. Case diameter: 41.50mm Case thickness: 12.35mm total case height. Lug-to-lug distance: 47.80mm Mechanical movement: Hand-wound TY2901 chronograph. Water resistance: 10ATM Glass: Flat sapphire crystal with a bevelled edge, subtle blue tinted anti-reflective coating on the inside. Dial: Dual layer dial, sunburst finished, with applied polished indices with BGW9 luminous material. Hands: Polished hour & minute hands with BGW9, painted chrono second hand, painted sub-dial hands. Bezel: Bevelled and polished fixed bezel. Strap: Supplied with a custom-made top-quality leather strap. At the heart of the Sports Chronotimer collection beats the remarkable 22-jewel TY2901 chronograph movement, a tribute to timeless watchmaking, delivering mechanical precision with every tick. Crafted at the Tianjin watch factory, this reliable hand-wound movement is based on the vintage Swiss Venus Calibre 175 design, featuring blued screws and polished, bevelled bridges with intricate patterns. It offers impressive accuracy, with a deviation of around 20 seconds per day, and is completed by a power reserve of approximately 42-hours. With 10ATM water resistance, this chronograph is both durable and refined, perfectly suited for everything from boardroom meetings to weekend getaways. Protected by a flat sapphire crystal with a bevelled edge, the dial of the Sports Chronotimer is a true spectacle. The subtle, blue-tinted anti-reflective coating on the inside of the crystal ensures readability in any light, allowing the sunburst-finished dual-layer dial to shine with sophistication. The dial is adorned with polished indices, illuminated by BGW9 luminous material, providing legibility even in low light. The polished hour and minute hands are also treated with BGW9 for nighttime visibility, while the painted chronograph seconds hand and sub-dial hands bring a pop of colour and contrast. Encased by a bevelled and polished fixed bezel, the Sports Chronotimer exudes a refined balance of sportiness and elegance. Completing the design is a custom-made, top-quality leather strap, offering both comfort and durability. The strap’s fine craftsmanship perfectly complements the watch, ensuring it looks as good on casual days as it does when dressed up for formal occasions.

The remodelled three-piece case is presented with polished and brushed details, a screw-down crown and case back, drilled through lugs and measures at a slim 12.05mm in total case height. Crafted from durable stainless steel, the 41.50mm cushion-style case is accentuated with a custom colour insert on the crown, adding a unique flair to this elegant timepiece. Cleverly designed to wear smaller than its dimensions might suggest, the watch sits comfortably on the wrist while the 47.80mm lug-to-lug distance ensures a balanced fit for any occasion. Case material: Stainless steel with custom colour insert on crown and tube. Case diameter: 41.50mm. Case thickness: 12.05mm total case height. Lug-to-lug distance: 47.80mm. Mechanical movement: Automatic winding TMI NH38 time-only movement. Water resistance: 10ATM. Glass: Flat sapphire crystal with a bevelled edge, subtle blue-tinted anti-reflective coating on the inside. Dial: Dual layer, brushed, with applied indices and BGW9 luminous material. Hands: Polished hour & minute hands with BGW9. Bezel: Bevelled and polished fixed bezel. Strap: Top quality rubber strap with folding buckle. At the heart of the Pioneer beats the reliable TMI NH38 movement, a tribute to timeless watchmaking, delivering mechanical precision with every tick. Designed and manufactured by Seiko Instruments, this is a reliable automatic winding movement, offering impressive accuracy, with a deviation of around 20 seconds per day, and is completed by a power reserve of approximately 42 hours. With 10ATM water resistance, this watch is both durable and refined, perfectly suited for everything from boardroom meetings to weekend getaways. Protected by a flat sapphire crystal with a bevelled edge, the dial of the Pioneer is a true spectacle. The subtle, blue-tinted anti-reflective coating on the inside of the crystal ensures readability in any light, allowing the sunburst-finished dual-layer dial to shine with sophistication. The dial is adorned with polished indices, illuminated by BGW9 luminous material, providing legibility even in low light. The polished hour and minute hands are also treated with BGW9 for nighttime visibility, while the fume dials bring a pop of colour and contrast. Encased by a bevelled and polished fixed bezel, the Pioneer exudes a refined balance of sportiness and elegance. Completing the design is a top-quality rubber strap, offering both comfort and durability. The strap’s fine craftsmanship perfectly complements the watch, ensuring it looks as good on casual days as it does when dressed up for formal occasions.

watches.name: Airstream Blue Dial
watches.description: Timeless design meets modern craftsmanship A beautifully balanced automatic watch inspired by the golden age of travel and adventure. With its sleek 36mm case and understated sophistication, the Airstream is a versatile companion that bridges vintage charm with contemporary style. Crafted from solid 316L stainless steel , the Airstream’s case features a polished and brushed finish , offering both durability and refined elegance. The curved-edge double-domed sapphire crystal enhances legibility while adding a touch of vintage warmth to the design. Beneath the crystal, a subtle gradient dial captures the light with effortless depth, complemented by applied hour markers and bold hands for easy readability. Powered by the Miyota Caliber 9015 automatic movement , the Airstream delivers reliable performance and smooth operation. Its screw-in crown ensures a confident 100m (330ft) water resistance , making it ready for everyday wear and weekend exploration alike. Designed for comfort and style, the 45.5mm lug-to-lug profile and 20mm strap width create a perfectly proportioned fit on the wrist. Paired with a soft leather strap, the Airstream transitions effortlessly from casual moments to more refined occasions. The Geckota Airstream is a celebration of refined British watch design - compact, capable, and effortlessly stylish. Whether you’re navigating city streets or charting your next adventure, this automatic watch is built to keep pace with your every journey.

watches.name: Airstream Frontier Watch Blue Textured Dial
watches.description: A modern evolution of a Geckota classic. The Geckota Airstream Frontier builds on the legacy of the original Airstream, refining its design and engineering to create a more capable, more characterful field watch. This second-generation model embraces the spirit of exploration that inspired the original, blending vintage utility with contemporary craftsmanship. Compact yet confident, the 36mm 316L stainless steel case strikes the ideal balance between versatility and presence. Its polished and brushed surfaces catch the light with subtle sophistication, while the black double-layer dial - detailed with a stamped grain texture - recalls the rugged beauty of 1960s field instruments. The fixed 24-hour bezel adds practical functionality and a hint of adventure, echoing the navigational tools that guided explorers into the unknown. Protected by a curved-edge double-domed sapphire crystal , the Frontier is powered by the dependable Miyota Caliber 9039 automatic movement - a Japanese engine celebrated for its smooth sweep and enduring precision. A screw-down crown and robust construction ensure reliability on any path, while a suede leather strap in rich brown tones completes the look with understated vintage charm. The Frontier Spirit Turn the watch over, and you’ll find Geckota’s signature anchor and serpent emblem engraved on the solid stainless steel case back - a powerful symbol of the Frontier’s identity. The anchor represents stability, craftsmanship, and the strength of tradition - the grounding force that defines Geckota’s approach to watchmaking. The serpent , coiled in motion, embodies adaptability, curiosity, and forward momentum. Together, they capture the spirit of the Frontier name: the harmony between skill and exploration, between heritage and progress. Proudly inscribed with “GECKOTA ENGLAND” and a unique serial number , each piece is part of a limited production run, crafted with care and individuality.

watches.name: Chronotimer Chronograph Watch Classic Reverse Panda
watches.description: Introducing the Chronotimer Panda Dial Chronograph, a bold addition to our range of Chronotimer chronograph racing watches. If you go back to the beginning, our first iteration of the Chronotimer, the C-01 – released back in 2017 – was inspired by the greatest racing watches of the 1960s, featuring round subdials with a stopwatch function, 24-hour timer, and contrasting tachymeter. But time moves on and we wanted to take Geckota in a slightly different design direction. We wanted to take vintage elements from our previous models and reintroduce them with a modern take establishing the Geckota design ethos that we still use today. The classic reverse dial adds a unique touch to the watch and gives it a distinct and sophisticated appearance. The double dome sapphire crystal provides added durability and scratch resistance, while the fully polished 316L stainless steel case gives it a sleek and polished look. The chronograph function and retro styling make it an ideal choice for those who appreciate both classic and modern design elements in a watch. The small sub dial on the right-hand side of the watch dial is typically used to display the ticking seconds, while the dial on the left is used to count the chronograph minutes when the stopwatch function is running. This is a standard layout for chronograph watches and makes it easy to read the elapsed time while the chronograph is running. Benefiting from a double dome sapphire crystal and a fully polished 316L stainless steel 42mm ‘cushion’ case, the Chronotimer is a standout watch with vintage racing-watch design cues and modern specs. A screw-down crown also enables a water-resistance rating of 100 meters (10ATM) and every Geckota Chronotimer also comes with a 2-year warranty. Each Chronotimer watch is supplied complete with a Geckota branded leather strap and is packaged in a high-quality watch case. All of our Models are made in very limited batches, and each case back features a unique serial number.

watches.name: Ocean-Scout Dive Watch Ice White
watches.description: With particular attention paid to the pure white, textured dial contrasting brilliantly against its black-outlined markers and black unidirectional bezel, the Geckota Ocean-Scout Ice Dial is a truly eye-catching timepiece. An expertly executed 316L stainless steel case has been built for endurance, whilst the removal of crown guards pays homage to classic dive watches. An anti-reflective sapphire box crystal further enhances the vintage aesthetic. Featuring lug-shaped to accommodate both steel and leather straps, whilst particular attention has been paid to how a military Nylon strap fits around the watch. A 60-minute diving bezel reinforces the 200m water-resistant capability of the watch. It features a classic 3, 6, and 9 dial design perfectly complementing the simplistic look of the dial. The raised hour-markers, whether that is numeral or baton, are equipped with blue glow BGW9 Super Luminova – low-legibility will never be an issue. Sword hands complement the vintage theme established by the crown and box crystal whilst a minute track circumnavigates the dial with the second's hand planned to the perfect length; just contacting the track. Not only are the hour-markers equipped with BGW9 Super Luminova but it also accompanies the sword hands and the bezel pip. This specific compound of luminescence remains stark white in daylight contributing to the sophisticated and clean look of the dial and produces a blue glow during twilight hours when fully charged. The lume perfectly complements the overall appearance of the watch, adding to the winter-inspired design. At the heart of the Ocean-Scout timepiece beats the automatic Miyota 9039 movement, representing the pinnacle of Miyota's Premium series. This exceptionally adept calibre boasts 24 meticulously crafted jewels, Para Shock protection, a commendable 42-hour power reserve, and a projected accuracy ranging from -10 to +30 seconds per day. Safeguarded by a custom-engraved case back adorned with the distinctive compass logo of the Ocean-Scout and a distinctive limited edition serial number, this movement remains concealed within its chamber, a testament to both it's precision and exclusivity.

watches.name: Ocean-Scout Dive Watch Sienna Brown
watches.description: Drawing inspiration from the rich pigments of our Earth, ranging from golden reddish tones to deep warm browns, the Ocean-Scout – Sienna Brown introduces the essence of our planet to the Ocean-Scout collection, presenting a distinctive colour palette guaranteed to make a striking impression. The Sienna Brown Ocean-Scout pays homage to the rich pigments of our Earth, and is supplied with a stainless steel bracelet and versatile nylon strap. Machined from 316L marine-grade stainless steel, the Ocean-Scout case is built for endurance. The removal of crown guards pays homage to classic dive watches and the anti-reflective sapphire box crystal further enhances the vintage aesthetic. The case between the lugs has been shaped to accommodate steel and leather straps with particular attention paid to how a Military Nylon strap fits around a watch. A 60-minute diving bezel reinforces the 200m water-resistant capability of the watch. The Ocean-Scout has a classic 3, 6, and 9 dial design available in a variety of different designs. Each hour marker, whether a numeral or baton, is crafted with raised and shaped luminescence. Sword hands complement the vintage theme established by the crown and crystal. A minute track circumnavigates the dial and the second hand has been planned to the perfect length; just making contact with the track. Low light legibility will never be an issue with the Ocean-Scout as the indices and hands are equipped with blue glow BGW9 Super Luminova. The bezel pip is also BGW9 treated. This specific compound of luminescence remains stark white in daylight giving a sophisticated clean and crisp look to the watch and offsets perfectly against the deep colour of the ocean-inspired dials. Powering the Ocean-Scout is an automatic Miyota 9039 movement, which falls within Miyota’s Premium line. This highly capable unit offers 24 Jewels, Para Shock protection, a power reserve of 42 hours and an expected accuracy of between -10 to +30 seconds per day. The movement is sealed away under a bespoke engraved case back which displays the stylised compass logo of the Ocean-Scout and shows the unique limited issue number of your watch.

watches.name: Ocean-Scout Dive Watch Frost
watches.description: The Geckota Ocean-Scout Frost model debuts our first-ever steel insert bezel for the adventurous Ocean-Scout. The brushed finish of the unidirectional bezel contrasts brilliantly with the polished surfaces of the 316L stainless steel case, still ensuring effortless legibility with a white engraved diver’s scale and luminous pip at 12 o’clock. With particular attention paid to the Frost, textured dial which contrasts brilliantly against the black-outlined markers, the Geckota Ocean-Scout Frost is a truly eye-catching timepiece. The lack of crown guards enhances the vintage aesthetic and brings to life some of the great dive watches from the 1960’s whilst an anti-reflective sapphire box crystal complements perfectly. The Ocean-Scout lugs are shaped to accommodate both steel and leather straps whilst particular attention has been paid to how a military Nylon strap fits around the watch. A 60-minute diving bezel reinforces the 200m water-resistant capability of the watch. It features a classic 3, 6, and 9 dial design perfectly complementing the simplistic look of the dial. The raised hour-markers, whether that is numeral or baton, are equipped with blue glow BGW9 Super Luminova – low-legibility will never be an issue. Sword hands complement the vintage theme established by the crown and box crystal whilst a minute track circumnavigates the dial with the second's hand planned to the perfect length; just contacting the track. Not only are the hour-markers equipped with BGW9 Super Luminova but it also accompanies the sword hands, the bezel pip and markers. This specific compound of luminescence remains stark white in daylight contributing to the sophisticated and clean look of the dial and produces a blue glow during twilight hours when fully charged. The lume perfectly complements the overall appearance of the watch adding to the winter-inspired design. At the heart of the Ocean-Scout timepiece beats the automatic Miyota 9039 movement, representing the pinnacle of Miyota's Premium series. This exceptionally adept calibre boasts 24 meticulously crafted jewels, Para Shock protection, a commendable 42-hour power reserve, and a projected accuracy ranging from -10 to +30 seconds per day. Safeguarded by a custom-engraved case back adorned with the distinctive compass logo of the Ocean-Scout and a distinctive limited edition serial number, this movement remains concealed within its chamber, a testament to both precision and exclusivity.

watches.name: Airstream Frontier Watch Brown Textured Dial
watches.description: A modern evolution of a Geckota classic. The Geckota Airstream Frontier builds on the legacy of the original Airstream, refining its design and engineering to create a more capable, more characterful field watch. This second-generation model embraces the spirit of exploration that inspired the original, blending vintage utility with contemporary craftsmanship. Compact yet confident, the 36mm 316L stainless steel case strikes the ideal balance between versatility and presence. Its polished and brushed surfaces catch the light with subtle sophistication, while the black double-layer dial - detailed with a stamped grain texture - recalls the rugged beauty of 1960s field instruments. The fixed 24-hour bezel adds practical functionality and a hint of adventure, echoing the navigational tools that guided explorers into the unknown. Protected by a curved-edge double-domed sapphire crystal , the Frontier is powered by the dependable Miyota Caliber 9039 automatic movement - a Japanese engine celebrated for its smooth sweep and enduring precision. A screw-down crown and robust construction ensure reliability on any path, while a suede leather strap in rich blue-grey tones completes the look with understated vintage charm. The Frontier Spirit Turn the watch over, and you’ll find Geckota’s signature anchor and serpent emblem engraved on the solid stainless steel case back - a powerful symbol of the Frontier’s identity. The anchor represents stability, craftsmanship, and the strength of tradition - the grounding force that defines Geckota’s approach to watchmaking. The serpent , coiled in motion, embodies adaptability, curiosity, and forward momentum. Together, they capture the spirit of the Frontier name: the harmony between skill and exploration, between heritage and progress. Proudly inscribed with “GECKOTA ENGLAND” and a unique serial number , each piece is part of a limited production run, crafted with care and individuality.

watches.name: Pioneer Special Edition Oxblood Red
watches.description: The remodelled three-piece case is presented with polished and brushed details, screw-down crown and case back, drilled through lugs and measures at a slim 12.05mm in total case height. Crafted from durable stainless steel, the 41.50mm cushion style case is accentuated with a custom colour insert on the crown, adding a unique flair to this elegant timepiece. Cleverly designed to wear smaller than its dimensions might suggest, the watch sits comfortably on the wrist while the 47.80mm lug-to-lug distance ensures a balanced fit for any occasion. Case material: Stainless steel with custom colour insert on crown and tube. Case diameter: 41.50mm. Case thickness: 12.05mm total case height. Lug-to-lug distance: 47.80mm. Mechanical movement: Automatic winding TMI NH38 time-only movement. Water resistance: 10ATM. Glass: Flat sapphire crystal with a bevelled edge, subtle blue tinted anti-reflective coating on the inside. Dial: Dual layer, brushed, with applied indices and BGW9 luminous material. Hands: Polished hour & minute hands with BGW9. Bezel: Bevelled and polished fixed bezel. Strap: Custom-made top-quality mesh bracelet or genuine leather strap. At the heart of the Pioneer beats the reliable TMI NH38 movement, a tribute to timeless watchmaking, delivering mechanical precision with every tick. Designed and manufactured by Seiko Instruments, this is a reliable automatic winding movement, offering impressive accuracy, with a deviation of around 20 seconds per day, and is completed by a power reserve of approximately 42 hours. With 10ATM water resistance, this watch is both durable and refined, perfectly suited for everything from boardroom meetings to weekend getaways. Protected by a flat sapphire crystal with a bevelled edge, the dial of the Pioneer is a true spectacle. The subtle, blue-tinted anti-reflective coating on the inside of the crystal ensures readability in any light, allowing the sunburst-finished dual-layer dial to shine with sophistication. The dial is adorned with polished indices, illuminated by BGW9 luminous material, providing legibility even in low light. The polished hour and minute hands are also treated with BGW9 for nighttime visibility, while the fume dials bring a pop of colour and contrast. Encased by a bevelled and polished fixed bezel, the Pioneer exudes a refined balance of sportiness and elegance. Completing the design is a custom-made, top-quality leather strap, offering both comfort and durability. The strap’s fine craftsmanship perfectly complements the watch, ensuring it looks as good on casual days as it does when dressed up for formal occasions.

watches.name: Chronotimer Chronograph Watch Gloss Black Racing Dial
watches.description: The Geckota Chronotimer Chronograph Watch is a high-quality timepiece that combines style, function and durability. You can be assured that this timepiece is of the same exceptional quality that you've come to expect of our brand, whilst maintaining a sensible price point. Each piece is engraved with an individual serial number with an extremely limited number of this beautiful edition available. The gloss dial adds a unique touch to the watch and gives it a distinct and sophisticated appearance. The chronograph function and retro styling make it an ideal choice for those who appreciate both classic and modern design elements in a watch. The small sub-dial on the right-hand side of the watch dial displays running seconds, while the dial at 9 counts chronograph minutes when the stopwatch function is running. This is a standard layout for chronograph watches and makes it easy to read the elapsed time while the chronograph is running. Benefiting from a double dome sapphire crystal and a fully polished 316L stainless steel 42mm ‘cushion’ case, the Chronotimer is a standout watch with vintage racing-watch design cues and modern specs. A screw-down crown also enables a water-resistance rating of 100 meters (10ATM) and every Geckota Chronotimer is supplied with a 2-year warranty. Each Chronotimer watch is supplied complete with a Geckota branded leather strap and is packaged in a high-quality watch case. All of our watches are made in very limited numbers, and each case has a unique serial number.

watches.name: Pioneer Automatic Watch Black Honeycomb
watches.description: The past, perfected - meet the modern Pioneer. A reinterpretation of a modern classic, the Pioneer combines vintage-inspired aesthetics with contemporary mechanics. Designed to be versatile, striking, and meticulously executed, this timepiece captures both everyday elegance and technical integrity. Design & Aesthetics The dial is finished with a radial brushed effect and subtle fumé (gradient) shading that darkens toward the edges, giving depth and visual interest without clutter. A delicate crosshair motif intersects the dial’s centre, subtly improving readability and reinforcing the vintage character. Applied trapezoid indices, enclosed by a crisp minute track, maintain clarity and balance. Hands are styled in a hybrid: the seconds hand gives sporting flair, while the large hour and minute hands lend a refined, dressy tone. All indices and hands are treated with Super-LumiNova® for strong legibility in low light. Case & Comfort Built from 316L stainless steel, the three-piece cushion-style case features highly polished surfaces for contrast and refinement. Dimensions: 42mm diameter, approximately 14mm thick (including the domed sapphire), and a lug-to-lug of 45mm and designed to wear smaller than its measurement suggests. A screw-down case back and crown help seal the movement. On some variants, the crown incorporates a custom-colour insert, a subtle detail that echoes Geckota’s bespoke sensibility. Drilled-through lugs simplify strap changes for customisation. Movement & Performance At its heart beats the Seiko / TMI NH35 (or NH38, depending on the model) automatic movement (24 jewels), fully mechanical, with both hand-winding and hacking seconds. Power reserve is approximately 41–42 hours, with factory-tested accuracy in the range of –20 to +40 seconds per day. Durability & Usability Domed sapphire crystal with internal anti-reflective coating guards the dial while ensuring clarity from most angles. Water resistance is rated to 30ATM (300m) - sufficient for swimming, splashes, and daily wear. Each watch is engraved with a unique serial number. Geckota offers a 2-year guarantee to support buyer confidence. Included with the Watch A premium custom-made Geckota-branded leather strap. Cleaning cloth and warranty card.

watches.name: Pioneer Automatic Watch Brushed Black Dial
watches.description: The past, perfected - meet the modern Pioneer. A reinterpretation of a modern classic, the Pioneer combines vintage-inspired aesthetics with contemporary mechanics. Designed to be versatile, striking, and meticulously executed, this timepiece captures both everyday elegance and technical integrity. Design & Aesthetics The dial is finished with a radial brushed effect and subtle fumé (gradient) shading that darkens toward the edges, giving depth and visual interest without clutter. A delicate crosshair motif intersects the dial’s centre, subtly improving readability and reinforcing the vintage character. Applied trapezoid indices, enclosed by a crisp minute track, maintain clarity and balance. Hands are styled in a hybrid: the seconds hand gives sporting flair, while the large hour and minute hands lend a refined, dressy tone. All indices and hands are treated with Super-LumiNova® for strong legibility in low light. Case & Comfort Built from 316L stainless steel, the three-piece cushion-style case features highly polished surfaces for contrast and refinement. Dimensions: 42mm diameter, approximately 14mm thick (including the domed sapphire), and a lug-to-lug of 45mm and designed to wear smaller than its measurement suggests. A screw-down case back and crown help seal the movement. On some variants, the crown incorporates a custom-colour insert, a subtle detail that echoes Geckota’s bespoke sensibility. Drilled-through lugs simplify strap changes for customisation. Movement & Performance At its heart beats the Seiko / TMI NH35 (or NH38, depending on the model) automatic movement (24 jewels), fully mechanical, with both hand-winding and hacking seconds. Power reserve is approximately 41–42 hours, with factory-tested accuracy in the range of –20 to +40 seconds per day. Durability & Usability Domed sapphire crystal with internal anti-reflective coating guards the dial while ensuring clarity from most angles. Water resistance is rated to 30ATM (300m) - sufficient for swimming, splashes, and daily wear. Each watch is engraved with a unique serial number. Geckota offers a 2-year guarantee to support buyer confidence. Included with the Watch A premium custom-made Geckota-branded leather strap. Cleaning cloth and warranty card.

watches.name: Ocean-Scout Dive Watch Emerald Green
watches.description: Machined from 316L marine-grade stainless steel, the Ocean-Scout case is built for endurance. The removal of crown guards pays homage to classic dive watches and the anti-reflective sapphire box crystal further enhances the vintage aesthetic. The case between the lugs has been shaped to accommodate steel and leather straps with particular attention paid to how a Military Nylon strap fits around a watch. A 60-minute diving bezel reinforces the 200m water resistant capability of the watch. The Ocean-Scout has a classic 3, 6, 9 dial design available in blue, green, or black. Each hour marker, whether a numeral or baton, is crafted with raised and shaped luminescence. Sword hands complement the vintage theme established by the crown and crystal. A minute track circumnavigates the dial and the seconds hand has been planned to the perfect length; just making contact with the track. Low light legibility will never be an issue with the Ocean-Scout as the indices and hands are equipped with blue glow BGW9 Super Luminova. The bezel pip is also BGW9 treated. This specific compound of luminescence remains stark white in daylight giving a sophisticated clean and crisp look to the watch and offsets perfectly against the deep colour of the ocean inspired dials. Powering the Ocean-Scout is an automatic Miyota 9039 movement, which falls within Miyota’s Premium line. This highly capable unit offers 24 Jewels, Para Shock protection, a power reserve of 42 hours and expected accuracy of between -10 to +30 seconds per day. The movement is sealed away under a bespoke engraved caseback which displays the stylised compass logo of the Ocean-Scout and shows the unique limited issue number of your watch.

watches.name: Sea-Hunter Dive Watch Marine Blue Steel Edition
watches.description: Sea-Hunter Marine Blue Steel Edition Deep colour meets the purposeful character of a classic dive watch in the Sea-Hunter Marine Blue Steel Edition. Its rich blue dial changes subtly with the light, appearing almost black in subdued conditions before revealing its marine-blue character in brighter surroundings. The defining feature is its brushed stainless-steel diving bezel. Etched and ink-filled markings provide crisp contrast, while the luminous marker at 12 o’clock helps retain visibility in darker conditions. Paired with the polished and brushed five link bracelet, the steel bezel gives the watch a more refined and versatile appearance than a conventional dive-watch insert. The 40mm stainless-steel case is proportioned to feel substantial without becoming oversized. Its 47mm lug-to-lug length helps it sit comfortably across the wrist, while the curved-edge sapphire crystal adds a subtle vintage influence and provides excellent everyday scratch resistance. Applied hour markers, clearly defined hands and Super-LumiNova across the dial support easy reading in changing light. A practical date display sits at 3 o’clock, while the screw-down crown, screw-in case back and 200-metre water resistance give the Sea-Hunter genuine dive-watch capability. Inside is the automatic PT5000 movement, offering hand winding, hacking seconds and approximately 40 hours of power reserve. Each Marine Blue Steel Edition is individually numbered and limited to just 75 pieces. Why choose this watch? watches.description: Sea-Hunter Dive Watch with Blue Bezel The Blue Bezel Sea-Hunter takes its inspiration directly from the ocean, combining a deep blue dial and matching bezel with the balanced proportions of a vintage dive watch. The result is colourful without becoming overstated and sporty without sacrificing everyday versatility. The 120-click unidirectional bezel is finished with a transparent resin insert that protects the printed timing scale and applied luminous marker at 12 o’clock. The resin gives the bezel a distinctive glossy depth, while the blue changes subtly with the surrounding light - from an almost black navy indoors to a richer marine tone in brighter conditions. The matching blue dial features applied hour markers, clearly defined hands and a precise minute track around its outer edge. The seconds hand extends neatly towards the track, contributing to the considered, well-proportioned appearance of the dial. Super-LumiNova improves visibility after dark, while the date window at 3 o’clock adds everyday convenience. The polished and brushed 316L stainless-steel case measures 40mm in diameter and 47mm from lug to lug. These proportions provide the reassuring presence expected of a dive watch while remaining comfortable on a wide range of wrist sizes. A curved-edge box sapphire crystal adds vintage character alongside modern scratch resistance and an underside anti-reflective coating. A screw-down crown, screw-in case back and 200-metre water resistance provide genuine aquatic capability. The automatic PT5000 movement offers hand winding, hacking seconds, a quick-set date and approximately 40 hours of power reserve. watches.description: Drawing inspiration from the rich pigments of our Earth, ranging from golden reddish tones to deep warm browns, the Ocean-Scout – Sienna Brown introduces the essence of our planet to the Ocean-Scout collection, presenting a distinctive colour palette guaranteed to make a striking impression. The Sienna Brown Ocean-Scout pays homage to the rich pigments of our Earth, and is supplied with a stainless steel bracelet and versatile nylon strap. Machined from 316L marine-grade stainless steel, the Ocean-Scout case is built for endurance. The removal of crown guards pays homage to classic dive watches and the anti-reflective sapphire box crystal further enhances the vintage aesthetic. The case between the lugs has been shaped to accommodate steel and leather straps with particular attention paid to how a Military Nylon strap fits around a watch. A 60-minute diving bezel reinforces the 200m water-resistant capability of the watch. The Ocean-Scout has a classic 3, 6, and 9 dial design available in a variety of different designs. Each hour marker, whether a numeral or baton, is crafted with raised and shaped luminescence. Sword hands complement the vintage theme established by the crown and crystal. A minute track circumnavigates the dial and the second hand has been planned to the perfect length; just making contact with the track. Low light legibility will never be an issue with the Ocean-Scout as the indices and hands are equipped with blue glow BGW9 Super Luminova. The bezel pip is also BGW9 treated. This specific compound of luminescence remains stark white in daylight giving a sophisticated clean and crisp look to the watch and offsets perfectly against the deep colour of the ocean-inspired dials. Powering the Ocean-Scout is an automatic Miyota 9039 movement, which falls within Miyota’s Premium line. This highly capable unit offers 24 Jewels, Para Shock protection, a power reserve of 42 hours and an expected accuracy of between -10 to +30 seconds per day. The movement is sealed away under a bespoke engraved case back which displays the stylised compass logo of the Ocean-Scout and shows the unique limited issue number of your watch.

watches.name: Pioneer Automatic Watch Brushed Green Dial
watches.description: The past, perfected - meet the modern Pioneer. A reinterpretation of a modern classic, the Pioneer combines vintage-inspired aesthetics with contemporary mechanics. Designed to be versatile, striking, and meticulously executed, this timepiece captures both everyday elegance and technical integrity. Design & Aesthetics The dial is finished with a radial brushed effect and subtle fumé (gradient) shading that darkens toward the edges, giving depth and visual interest without clutter. A delicate crosshair motif intersects the dial’s centre, subtly improving readability and reinforcing the vintage character. Applied trapezoid indices, enclosed by a crisp minute track, maintain clarity and balance. Hands are styled in a hybrid: the seconds hand gives sporting flair, while the large hour and minute hands lend a refined, dressy tone. All indices and hands are treated with Super-LumiNova® for strong legibility in low light. Case & Comfort Built from 316L stainless steel, the three-piece cushion-style case features highly polished surfaces for contrast and refinement. Dimensions: 42mm diameter, approximately 14mm thick (including the domed sapphire), and a lug-to-lug of 45mm and designed to wear smaller than its measurement suggests. A screw-down case back and crown help seal the movement. On some variants, the crown incorporates a custom-colour insert, a subtle detail that echoes Geckota’s bespoke sensibility. Drilled-through lugs simplify strap changes for customisation. Movement & Performance At its heart beats the Seiko / TMI NH35 (or NH38, depending on the model) automatic movement (24 jewels), fully mechanical, with both hand-winding and hacking seconds. Power reserve is approximately 41–42 hours, with factory-tested accuracy in the range of –20 to +40 seconds per day. Durability & Usability Domed sapphire crystal with internal anti-reflective coating guards the dial while ensuring clarity from most angles. Water resistance is rated to 30ATM (300m) - sufficient for swimming, splashes, and daily wear. Each watch is engraved with a unique serial number. Geckota offers a 2-year guarantee to support buyer confidence. Included with the Watch A premium custom-made Geckota-branded leather strap. Cleaning cloth and warranty card.
